cards.ex: The tabloid paper really dug up some serious dirt on the mayor during the investigation.
cards.exUz: Sariq matbuot tergov davomida hokim haqida jiddiy kir qazib oldi.
cards.uzDef: Birov haqida yomon, sharmandali ma'lumot topish.

cards.ex: The man police apprehended fit the description given by the witness perfectly.
cards.exUz: Politsiya ushlagan odam guvoh bergan ta'rifga juda mos edi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning tashqi ko'rinishi ta'rifga to'g'ri keladi.

cards.ex: The accountant was meticulous; there was a clear paper trail for every transaction.
cards.exUz: Buxgalter juda ehtiyotkor edi; har bir operatsiya uchun aniq hujjat izi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Qog'oz yoki elektron hujjatlar orqali qoldirilgan dalil.

cards.ex: The police jumped the gun and arrested the wrong person, based on flimsy evidence.
cards.exUz: Politsiya yengil dalillarga asoslanib, adashib notog'ri odamni hibsga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqti kelmasdan oldin biror ishni boshlash.

cards.ex: The missing money immediately threw suspicion on the treasurer.
cards.exUz: Yo'qolgan pul darhol g'aznachiga shubha uyg'otdi.

cards.ex: The witness testified under oath that she saw the defendant at the scene.
cards.exUz: Guvoh sudga qasamyod qilib, ayblanuvchini voqea joyida ko'rganini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda qasamyod qilib, rost gapirishga va'da berib.

cards.ex: The prosecutor's case was on shaky ground after the key witness recanted.
cards.exUz: Asosiy guvoh o'z ko'rsatmasidan voz kechgandan so'ng, prokurorning ishi nozik vaziyatga tushib qoldi.

cards.ex: The wrongly convicted man's release was a relief, but the case remains a terrible miscarriage of justice.
cards.exUz: Noto'g'ri hukm qilingan odamning ozod qilinishi yengillik edi, ammo bu ish dahshatli adolatsizlik bo'lib qolmoqda.

cards.ex: He spent years trying to clear his name after being wrongly accused of fraud.
cards.exUz: U noto'g'ri firibgarlikda ayblanganidan keyin o'z nomini oqlashga yillar sarfladi.

cards.ex: The plea bargain was negotiated behind closed doors, with no public access.
cards.exUz: Aybdorlikni tan olish yuzasidan kelishuv yopiq eshiklar ortida, jamoatchilikka kirish huquqisiz muzokara qilindi.

cards.ex: After the robbery, he immediately became the prime suspect because of his past record.
cards.exUz: O'g'irlikdan so'ng, u o'zining o'tmishdagi rekordi tufayli darhol asosiy gumonlanuvchiga aylandi.

cards.ex: After exposing the corruption, the journalist found himself in the crosshairs of powerful people.
cards.exUz: Korruptsiyani fosh qilgandan so'ng, jurnalist o'zini qudratli odamlarning nishonida topdi.

cards.ex: The detectives managed to turn up some crucial evidence at the crime scene.
cards.exUz: Detektivlar jinoyat joyida muhim dalillarni topishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.

cards.ex: The FBI conducted a sting operation to catch the art thieves.
cards.exUz: FBI san'at o'g'rilarini qo'lga olish uchun maxfiy operatsiya o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoiy faoliyatni fosh qilish uchun maxfiy operatsiya.

cards.ex: The new evidence casts doubt on the defendant's alibi.
cards.exUz: Yangi dalillar ayblanuvchining alibisiga shubha tug'diradi.

cards.ex: The investigators noticed a disturbing pattern of behavior in the suspect's past.
cards.exUz: Tergovchilar gumonlanuvchining o'tmishida bezovta qiluvchi xulq-atvor namunasini payqashdi.

cards.ex: The police are closing in on the suspect, who is believed to be hiding in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Politsiya tog'larda yashirinayotgan deb taxmin qilinayotgan gumonlanuvchiga yaqinlashmoqda.

cards.ex: The embezzlement was a major breach of trust, as he betrayed his colleagues.
cards.exUz: O'g'irlik ishonchni suiiste'mol qilishning asosiy namunasi bo'ldi, chunki u hamkasblariga xiyonat qildi.

cards.ex: We need to get to the bottom of why these documents were leaked to the press.
cards.exUz: Nima uchun bu hujjatlar matbuotga sizdirilganligining sababini aniqlashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: He's really behind the eight ball after losing all that money gambling.
cards.exUz: U qimorda pulini yo'qotib, haqiqatan ham qiyin ahvolda qoldi.

cards.ex: Some people argue that gambling is a victimless crime, but it can ruin lives.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilar qimor jabrlanuvchisiz jinoyat, deb hisoblashadi, ammo u hayotni buzishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga bevosita zarar yetkazmaydigan jinoyat.

cards.ex: He cooked up a story about being robbed, but the police didn't believe him.
cards.exUz: U o'g'irlanganligi haqida hikoya to'qidi, lekin politsiya unga ishonmadi.

cards.ex: The company tried to stonewall the investigation by refusing to hand over documents.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya hujjatlarni topshirishdan bosh tortib, tergovga to'sqinlik qilishga harakat qildi.

cards.ex: The stolen paintings were eventually found under lock and key in a private vault.
cards.exUz: O'g'irlangan rasmlar oxir-oqibat xususiy omborda qulflangan holda topildi.

cards.ex: The lawyer's explanation of the law was as clear as mud.
cards.exUz: Advokatning qonun haqidagi tushuntirishi loyqadek tushunarsiz edi.

cards.ex: The prisoners held a kangaroo court to punish the inmate who had betrayed them.
cards.exUz: Mahbuslar ularga xiyonat qilgan mahbusni jazolash uchun soxta sud o'tkazdilar.
cards.uzDef: Adolatsiz, qonuniy asosga ega bo'lmagan sud.

cards.ex: The detectives vowed to leave no stone unturned in their search for the missing child.
cards.exUz: Detektivlar bedarak yo'qolgan bolani qidirishda hech narsani chetda qoldirmaslikka va'da berishdi.

cards.ex: The authorities often turn a blind eye to the illegal activities happening in the area.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ko'pincha hududda sodir bo'layotgan noqonuniy harakatlarga ko'z yumadi.

cards.ex: After years of feuding, the families finally decided to bury the hatchet.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yillik adovatdan so'ng, oilalar nihoyat urushni to'xtatishga qaror qilishdi.

cards.ex: Finding the real killer after so many years is a long shot, but we have to try.
cards.exUz: Shuncha yildan keyin haqiqiy qotilni topish kichik imkoniyat, lekin biz harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshish ehtimoli kam bo'lgan narsa.
